content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Manchester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and meet PMI's education requirement. The CAPM stands apart because no project management work experience is required—ideal if you're transitioning into the field or early in your career.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK Guide and core project management frameworks, delivered by experienced instructors with built-in flexibility for Manchester professionals balancing work and study.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM application, documenting your secondary degree and completion of required education hours. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI to activate your eligibility window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides aligned to the CAPM exam blueprint. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your CAPM active. Granite PM Academy offers resources to help you meet ongoing professional development requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
